Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.

The diff only adds static UI translation strings (tab labels, titles, descriptions, auth gate messaging) to three i18n message files. There are no:
- Dynamic values or interpolation placeholders
- Attacker-influenceable inputs
- Sinks (no HTML, no shell, no SQL, no logging of the new strings)
- Auth/authorization logic changes (the "authGate" strings are UI copy — the actual gate lives elsewhere in code, which this diff does not touch)
- Registry keys that would need corresponding consumer updates for security

Static translation additions have no security surface.
